objective: Define a first-class semantic loop exit policy that preserves uncertainty and distinguishes a successful exit from a resource stop.

requirements.statement: An accepted high-confidence unknown or insufficient result remains review, never successful completion.
Successful completion requires a specifically declared completion label, validated distribution, explicit probability and margin thresholds, and a successfully consumed current-round observation.
Budget, deadline, cancellation, and stalled-state stops remain distinct from satisfying the semantic objective.

candidates.description: Map declared finite labels explicitly to complete, continue, or review; map unknown and insufficient to review. Validate the distribution and apply probability and margin thresholds. Permit successful completion only for a declared completion label from a successful consumed current-round observation. Record round or call budgets, timeout, cancellation, and stalled-state termination separately from completion.

Stop successfully whenever any label has high confidence, including unknown. Treat budget exhaustion and cancellation as successful completion. Do not link exit to a consumed current-round observation.
